description.value: The Dayton Audio MX5-22 subwoofer allows high-energy bass performance from a compact 5-1/4" format, delivering surprising depth and impact from installations where space is in short supply. Its long-throw motor, vented architecture, and distortion-reducing aluminum shorting sleeve work together to keep bass tight, clean, and controlled in both home and car audio builds. A cone filling inverted dust cap gives the MX5-22 a modern, refined look, while its durable construction stands up to the demands of continuous high-excursion use. Thanks to its dual 2-ohm voice coils, the MX5-22 integrates easily with a wide range of amplifiers, making powerful low-frequency performance accessible almost anywhere. Product Highlights Long-throw motor and low resonance frequency support strong bass output from ultra-compact enclosures Full-coverage concave dust cap reinforces the cone while creating a clean, modern look Aluminum shorting sleeve stabilizes inductance for reduced distortion across the stroke Durable suspension tuned for sustained high excursion with predictable, linear motion Vented motor design improves airflow to keep temperatures down and compression low Dual 2-ohm voice coils offer flexible wiring for optimal amplifier pairing Precision-tooled steel frame provides the mechanical clearance required for deep travel

model.value: MX5-22 5-1/4" Max-X High Excursion DVC Subwoofer Driver 2 Ohms Per Coil
